name: SIMPPLE LTD. Ordinary Shares
summary: Simpple Ltd. engages in the provision of property technology space. It operates through the following segments: Robots, Software Services Rendered, and Others. The Robots segment refers to the sale of autonomous robotic cleaning equipment. The Software Services Rendered segment involves in the sale of facilities management applications. The company was founded by Jie Xiang Chong and Kah Kit Pat on August 24, 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore.
